summary: Fix committed; after-measurement passes AC-2 budget
progress_summary: Root cause verified in code: three synchronous full scans of ~/.gwt/sessions at startup. Implemented background wizard ledger, candidate-only startup recovery read with a deferred Interrupted sweep, removal of the unused worktree session_ids, and a perf.startup session_load phase with count. Tests green (lib perf::startup 5/5, lib worktree_inventory 1/1, worktree_inventory_test 5/5, bin startup_recovery 4/4 + wizard/auto-resume 8/8), clippy -D warnings clean, fmt and diff --check clean. After-measurement on an isolated HOME (8 restored shells + 1,275 stopped Sessions, 99 within 24h): first_frame 4,721 ms (budget 5.0 s, passed), workspace_restore 84 ms, session_load 1,040 ms. A first attempt with non-stopped copied Sessions auto-resumed 17 of them into the fixture tab; the fixture now forces Stopped.
